The Quran as a grid

Search the Quran and see where every word falls

Every square below is one of the Quran's 77,429 words, read like an Arabic page from the top right. Type any word, root or idea and each match lights up as a white dot. Or open a discovery: popular number claims tested honestly, people, nature, structure and more.

ٱقْرَأْ iqraʾ · read · 96:1
    month
    English word-by-word meaning, whole words (month* also finds months)
    شمس
    Arabic: a root if it is one, otherwise a spelling
    root:رحم
    Every word built on a root
    lemma:شَهْر
    One dictionary word, all its forms
    ar:كتاب
    Spelling contains (ar:=كتاب for the exact word)
    tr:"sacred month"
    Verses whose English translation has the phrase
    tag:PN
    Grammar tag: PN proper noun, ADJ, NEG, VOC, INL…
    pos:V
    Part of speech: N noun, V verb, P particle
    surah:2 · juz:30
    Limit to a surah, juz, page or range (surah:1-10)
    type:meccan
    Meccan or Medinan surahs
    2:255 · ref:2:1-5
    Particular verses
    has:"root:قمر"
    Verses containing such a word (two has: terms means both in one verse)

    Spaces mean AND, | means OR, commas list alternatives (root:شمس,قمر) and a leading minus excludes (-tag:DET). at:last keeps only the last word of each verse.

      How the grid is built

      The text is split into words exactly as the Quranic Arabic Corpus splits it: 77,429 words in 6,236 verses. The grid is the smallest near-square that holds them, 279 columns by 278 rows, with the last 133 squares empty. Verses use 79 × 79 and the 604 pages of the Madani mushaf use 25 × 25.

      Roots, dictionary forms and grammar tags come from the corpus. English meanings are Quran.com's word-by-word glosses, and verse translations are Saheeh International. Searching ignores vowel marks and folds Arabic letter variants together (أ إ آ ٱ as ا, ى as ي, ة as ه).

      The revelation order sorts whole surahs by the traditional sequence Tanzil lists. Verses inside each surah keep their usual order.

      About the discoveries

      Each discovery is a saved search. Its counts are recomputed when the page is built, and the build stops if any count is wrong. Every discovery was found by a research pass over the data and then re-checked by a separate pass that tried to disprove it. Number claims that circulate online are tested under plain counting rules, and the verdict says which rule, if any, gives the claimed number.
